benchmarks.conditions: Real temporary filesystem; VS Code stub; durable barriers retained; deterministic fixtures; no production data or Provider traffic.

limitations: Profile hard delivery overflow yields explicit legal partial; unaccepted full original body is not retained or advertised as readable.
Old child records without controlled inheritance proof remain audit-readable but cannot resume execution.
Reader small-result cold IO and legacy first parse can be slower; persistence is not claimed to be uniformly faster.
The offline delegation task has lower parent context but higher total estimated input after coordination; it does not establish actual cost savings or semantic quality.
Real model adoption, real usage, VS Code interaction and long-running task quality remain unverified.
